name: Kedyson

facts.text: Kedyson as one dead man raised twice by two rivals is Living Server writing (the zone file's sketch).

story:
Kedyson was a man of the dales once, and nobody remembers what he did, because he has been a skeleton longer than he was anything else. Two young drakoran of the middle ground, Arel Birn and Ra'ris Delum, both claim to have raised him, and both did.

Fort Gwyntell's registrar, Gracien Adamson, tells it like this. Arel Birn raised Kedyson first, badly, from a grave by the training dummies, and was proud of it. Ra'ris Delum said the raising was crooked and raised him again, properly, from the same grave, which should not have been possible and was. Now there are two of Kedyson, standing a few paces apart on the middle ground, one beside each drakoran, each exactly like the other, and neither drakoran will give up theirs or say which is the right one.

The two Kedysons do not look at each other. The Priest of Arawn says that is the only sensible thing anyone on the middle ground has done.
legend: Kedyson, level 38 skeleton, is on the middle ground of the dales twice: two spawns a few paces apart, one next to Arel Birn and one next to Ra'ris Delum (both 34). Pull one Kedyson at a time and expect its drakoran to come along. Crush for the bones, plain melee, respawn 80 seconds. Good for a group in the high thirties.

aggro: Which of us do you want?

lairEntry: Two skeletons, each the same man, a few paces apart.
